name: Lalu Print - Main (print run, monitor, staff actions)

parameters.content:
# Lalu print automation (Phase 1)
One workflow, three flows:
**1 Print run** (daily 08:30 UK or manual) → **2 Monitor** (every 5 min) → **3 Staff actions** (HubSpot webhook).
HubSpot is the only state store. Edit settings ONLY in the **Config** node. See README.md for bindings. Activate only after the pilot checklist.

nodes.name: Staff action webhook
nodes.notes: Bind a Header Auth credential. HubSpot workflow "Send a webhook" sends header + body {"deal_id": "<Record ID>"}. Replies 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: ALL settings live here. Replace every REPLACE_ value. Property names/values match the Printing automation section in HubSpot.

parameters.content:
## 1. Print run
Guard → read queue → resolve destination → claim (Preparing) → per destination pack: download PDFs → manifest + merge → send to printer → record result. Any unsafe printer result stops the run (alert email).

nodes.name: Printer status check
nodes.notes: Pre-flight: bridge + printer state before anything is claimed.

nodes.name: Printer ready?
nodes.notes: ready / ready_warning continue. offline, jammed, paper_out, door_open, toner_empty, error, busy, unreachable => stop + alert email, nothing claimed.

nodes.name: Daily allowance
nodes.notes: Daily limit minus reports already sent today. 0 left => run ends quietly.

nodes.name: Build packs and claim updates
nodes.notes: Invalid cases go to Needs attention with the reason; valid cases are claimed as Preparing and grouped by destination (sorted).

nodes.name: Next pack
nodes.notes: Output 1 (loop) = next destination pack. Output 0 (done) = finished.

nodes.name: Download report
nodes.notes: Bind Header Auth credential: Name=Authorization, Value=Api-Key <key>.

nodes.name: Build pack PDF
nodes.notes: Sorts downloads into OK/failed (using EMR+ error codes) and prepares the manifest request.

nodes.name: Send pack to printer
nodes.notes: NO retries here: a retry could print twice. Timeouts/errors are treated as "unknown".

parameters.content:
## 2. Monitor (every 5 min)
Looks up every Preparing / Sent-to-printer job on the print bridge and updates HubSpot: Printed (+ release hold + existing stage handoff), Needs attention (failed, missing, timed out). Never prints anything.

## 3. Staff actions
HubSpot sends the deal ID. n8n re-reads the deal, validates the request (note required, no active job, etc.) and updates it. Rejections are written to the Print request note as "REJECTED: …". Action is reset to None.
